assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered.
CPT code 93229 is used for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
Diagnosis code I49.9 supports the claim.
Diagnosis code Z86.73 supports the claim.
